fixes.problem: The persona name labels are still drawn as opaque colored pills of uneven width (e.g. Luzia mint, Teacher lavender, Chef white, Languages striped) and sit lower than the real ones. The real screen has a full-width translucent strip across the bottom of each card, about 20px tall, with centered white text. Round 1 asked for this and the heatmap still shows red on every label.
fixes.fix: For each of the 15 cards, replace the pill with one strip that spans the card's full width at the bottom, about 20px tall, with background rgba(255,255,255,0.35) and a slight blur. Center the label in white, 14px medium weight, with its baseline near y=188 for row 1 (row pitch 129.1px). Remove the per-card colors, borders and any extra line above the strip.

fixes.problem: The 'Try something else' cards at the bottom are wrong: the bunny tile shows a bright red blob in the heatmap, and the plus tile has a red ring.
fixes.fix: Make the bunny tile a soft lavender-gray (#8f8fb0-ish) rounded square with a faint bunny drawing, as on the real screen. Make the plus tile #2a2a2a-ish with a white plus 22px wide. Use radius 16px and match each tile's position and size.

fixes.problem: The Hot/New/Creative/Arcade/Tools chip row is drawn with wider spacing and different icons. The real 'Hot' tab is 12px narrower and 'Tools' fits with its icon at x~347. The heatmap is red here and over the tab labels.
fixes.fix: Set the chip font to 14px medium. Place the labels at x: Hot 38, New 105, Creative 177, Arcade 277, Tools 372, with 16px outline icons directly left of each label. Keep the 2px white underline under Hot, about 48px wide.

fixes.problem: The bottom game cards under the chips (Chaos arcade and Chess 2000 ELO) render differently from the real ones: the pixel art is wrong, and the chess card has a brown frame and a different board top.
fixes.fix: Draw the left card with a dark navy background (#10142a) and the 'CHAOS 000000' header with the yellow 'WANTED' badge at the top left. Draw the right card in brown (#5a4536) with the 'Chess 2000 ELO' serif title at y=653 and a beige checkerboard from y=670. Keep both cards at 16px radius.

fixes.problem: The tab titles 'My Apps' and 'Explore', the tab-bar labels (Chat, Services, Create) and the card texts are bolder and about 1px off. The Chat icon shows a '3' where the real one shows a 'z' swirl.
fixes.fix: Lower the font weight by one step for these labels and shift the texts 1px down. Set the Chat icon to a chat-bubble with a swirl glyph, not a '3'. Keep the Create icon as is.

fixes.problem: The greeting paragraph is still red on every line: the text is heavier, about 1px too high, and slightly wider than the real text. The pill under 'Our new chat' is also drawn as a rounded outline with a wrong shape. The 'Ask Teacher' and footer texts are 1px off.
fixes.fix: Set the paragraph to weight 400 with the same 20px size, and shift it down 1px (first baseline about y=132). Set letter-spacing to -0.1px so the lines wrap at the same words. Draw the small pill at x 181-229, y 88-101 in dark gray with a hairline border. Move the footer text and 'Ask Teacher' down 1px.

fixes.problem: The hero art lower edge is off: the mock has a dark strip cut at about y=573 on the left, and the bottom edge of the card is not rounded like the real one. 'Open app' and the title texts are heavier and about 1px higher.
fixes.fix: Draw assets/s13.e03.art.png at x=12.2, y=72, 387x501.7, and set the card radius to 24px with a 1px #444 outline reaching y=617. Set the 'Open app' label to weight 500 and move it down 1px. Move 'Photoedit', 'By Luzia', 2K, 1.4K, Share and 'Report app' down 1px with a lighter weight.

fixes.problem: The Remix bar area is masked and the icon glyph differs slightly. The action-pill icons (heart red, bookmark orange) are slightly larger than the real ones.
fixes.fix: Draw assets/s13.e14.png at x=16, y=743.2, 379.4x39.6. Shrink the heart and bookmark icons to 14px and align them at x=66 and x=190.

summary: The layout is already accurate, with all data-el elements placed and every tap working, so the remaining gains come from visual fidelity. The biggest fixes are the s04 persona label strips, which are still opaque pills, the s14 chip row and game cards, and the text weight and 1px offsets in s15, s13 and s14. Lighter font weights and a 1px downward shift would clear most of the red..
